rules.rule: Current line is 'Live with Purpose, Dress with Ease' (site title). Never present the retired 'Bento Box' service as current; say 'personal styling'.

Never use any word on the compliance banned list (19 words) in customer-facing copy: eco-friendly, chemical-free, toxin-free, non-toxic, detox, hypoallergenic, antibacterial, cures, heals, eczema, dermatologist-approved, clinically proven, plastic-free, zero waste, carbon negative, climate positive, guaranteed, miracle, sweatshop-free.

Use the brand vocabulary: at least one brand word per asset (offer-only lines exempt). Brand words: polished, wardrobe, suiting, designed, pieces, piece, styling, stylist, styled, woman, women, work, office, effortless, ease, easy-care, machine washable, machine-washable, travel, purpose, tailored, crafted, engineered, season, power casual, bento, showroom, decisions, outfit, dress, blazer, trouser, sweater, gift, samantha, m dash, m.m., polish, professional, boss. Product pages use the product vocabulary: silhouette, fabric, crafted, machine washable, machine-washable, statement, classic, relaxed, streamlined, tailored, wear, designed, pockets, made in, limited edition, m.m., polished, suiting, drape, knit, cashmere, work, office, travel.
Write the brand name as 'M.M.LaFleur' in running copy. Never: MM LaFleur, MMLaFleur, M.M. LaFleur, MM.LaFleur, M.M.Lafleur.
Product names keep the M.M. pattern: first name + optional quoted nickname + garment + fabric (e.g. 'O'Hara "The Editor" Blazer - Everyday Crepe'). Never drop the fabric name on PDPs.
Serial comma: M.M.LaFleur uses both styles; no rule beyond clarity (observed 15 assets with, 16 without).
Prices drop trailing zeros: $26 not $26.00; keep cents only when non-zero.
Percentages as numerals with %: '20%' not 'twenty percent'.
Use an em dash for asides (spaced or closed, consistent in one asset); never double hyphens.
Emoji in product pages and web copy: none; email body: none.
Emoji per organic social caption: none.
Emoji per paid ad: none. Emoji used as list bullets in product call-outs do not count. All-caps words (excluding acronyms) per ad: up to 1; per social caption: none; per PDP: up to 1.
Exclamation marks: ads up to 0, social up to 0, PDP up to 0, web up to 0, email body up to 0.
Reading level: grade 13.5 or below (Flesch-Kincaid) for ads, email, web and PDP copy of 3+ sentences.
Sentences average 24 words or fewer (ads, email, web); a spaced em dash or an emoji counts as a break.
Speak to her as 'you'; the brand is 'we' or 'M.M.' (short form allowed after first mention); never 'the company'.
Recurring devices may be used as written: 'Some decisions are easy:' outfit posts, 'Samantha' vignettes, quote posts with attribution, and quoted product nicknames.

rules.rule: 'Starting at $X' only when an active, in-stock SKU is currently priced at $X.
'Up to X% off' only with the maximum stated in offers.csv for that offer.

Partner products (vendor = Partner) are never called 'designed by M.M.' or 'our fabric'; name the maker.
Never say every M.M. piece is machine washable; 47 SKUs in the feed are dry-clean only.
Fabric origin claims ('Italian fabric', 'Japanese crepe') only when in claims.md for that fabric.
Fiber percentages ('100% cashmere') only when the catalog material says so for that SKU.
Never disparage other brands by name (Theory, J.Crew, Ann Taylor).

Name products exactly as the catalog (first name, nickname, garment, fabric).

No comparative or superiority claims ('better than denim', 'the leading brand') unless in claims.md.

Hierarchy: H1, H2, H3, body, caption, legal; one H1 per page or email.

Never use third-party widget fonts in brand assets.
